notes.title: Discover the secrets of Washagami! #7
notes.notes:
[h1]Triple security[/h1]

[i]Rumors about the Sect's secret vault have long kept you awake. The unbelievable stories about fallen daredevils and impregnable security seemed to tempt you even harder than the contents of the cache themselves. What's certain, however, is that the cultists won't be eager to share their wealth....[/i].

[b]WARNING - SPOILER BELOW!!![/b]

[spoiler][b]GUIDE[/b]
1. Go to the spot marked on the map. There is a powerful boss next to the submarine - Bauer. Defeating him will allow you to go in the tunnel located behind his back.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38078745/ad262badc0a751c37b36cf20863cd43183e652a0.png[/img]
2. Next to the first door there is a mummy. Clicking on it will give you a clue leading to the first key.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38078745/73f34b1e6479c2a72e9e89761cbb199e409e9702.png[/img]
3. Go to the Washagami cemetery. Click on the ground next to the tombstone marked "BETELGEUSE". You will receive the first key.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38078745/11f9f373886a7d69d59e0b51742e1c73c588ad2d.png[/img]
4. Return to the tunnel by the submarine. After opening the first door and defeating the wave of enemies, you will find another clue in another nearby corpse.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38078745/363d513d3d468be86dcf9677670374b20b06f4e4.png[/img]
5. Go to the spot marked on the map.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38078745/c3279c5913519d1a7b17413585d1a77af1c6a91e.png[/img]
6. Go down into the mine and head to the end of the tunnel. In the cart you will find another key.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38078745/7a64cc986c46bcb072909fe2fa05e0325cfcbe84.png[/img]
7. After opening another door you will find the last corpse containing a clue.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38078745/22857017a713e95c589375644bc794f8d309423e.png[/img]
8. Go to the spot marked on the map.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38078745/c2a2257377970e74ff1889849371a52d774a7856.png[/img]
9. Next to the stairs leading to Black Paw there is a chest with the last key inside.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38078745/077856aca35ed52179a227d80e113a3276d3ea24.png[/img]
10. Back in the tunnel next to the submarine, open the chest and collect the treasures inside. [/spoiler]

notes.title: Say hello to M.E.A.T. II: Absolute Zero!
notes.notes:
[h2]We are honored to officially announce the upcoming sequel to M.E.A.T. RPG - [b]M.E.A.T. II: Absolute Zero[/b].[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38078745/6f91748092179cb15c9d4b709f8cea7f883bc3ab.jpg[/img]

[h2]New chapter[/h2]

What was originally intended to be just an expansion for M.E.A.T. RPG - like a telestarion mutant has evolved into a full-fledged, stand-alone game. Still having 90s nostalgia at heart, this time our attention was drawn to "classics" such as [b]Doom[/b] and [b]Duke Nukem 3D[/b]. For this reason, the most crucial decision was made regarding the type of gameplay- M.E.A.T. II is a so-called [b]"boomer shooter"[/b]. Certainly, there will be no shortage of grotesque opponents, deadly weapons and flowing blood.

[h2]Play the demo![/h2]

You can test the [b]free demo version of the game[/b] right now. To download just visit the Steam Store page of the game and click the "Download M.E.A.T. II Demo" button. The game demo is [b]continuously updated[/b] based on bugs and suggestions reported by players. We encourage you to both follow the story of new updates and express your opinion in the game's Community Zone.

The full version of the game is scheduled for release in [b]the fourth quarter of 2023[/b]. You can find more information on M.E.A.T. II: Absolute Zero's Steam page.

notes.title: Meet the Bosses featured in M.E.A.T.! #6
notes.notes:
[h1]Challenging enemies you will encounter in the game[/h1]

A rumbling echo accompanied your footsteps as you stepped carefully inside the deserted city cathedral. The smell of incense failed to mask the strange odor originating directly in front of you.
A feminine, demonic figure stared into your eyes. Hatred it emanated was undoubtedly frenzied, but at the same time, full of eerie intelligence. 
[b]With an inhuman, lacking-any-hesitation movement, the figure swung to attack.[/b] The swishing blows of the axe cut through the air unbelievably fast, forcing you to dodge at lightning speed. You knew this battle was the ultimate test for your body and mind - all the previous fights had given you the experience needed to prevail. There was no room for the slightest mistake, as not only your life was at stake, but your soul as well.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38078745/3b7558f9cf89d81e336e045b2a5ea1df79e9e699.jpg[/img]

Before your eyes stood the memory of the immense amount of work necessary to now meet the monster face to face. It all started with the rumors circulating in Washagami that shrill screams would come out of the church at night. Some time later, bestial attacks began to occur. The victims’ bodies were completely mangled and the few survivors were unable to utter a single word about the tragic events.
Investigating on your own led you to the traces of a mysterious and cruel organization. It took a long time for the clues you gathered to lead you to the person directly responsible for this madness.

[h2]Solve the mystery of the demonic Lilith and put an end to the townsfolk's suffering!
[/h2]

As part of a new series, we introduce you to the bosses you will encounter while exploring the town of Washagami! Lilith remains one of the biggest challenges you are going to face.

[b]Soon we will reveal the next boss you will encounter on your path.[/b]

notes.title: Meet the Bosses featured in M.E.A.T.! #4
notes.notes:
[h1]Challenging enemies you will encounter in the game[/h1]

The Indian village looked very different from the way you remembered it. A fire had ravaged the settlement and hordes of aggressive and variously mutated Indians attacked you relentlessly. Suddenly, all was quiet - leading you to your final destination.
[b]A large, horned demon stood near the village totem.[/b] The raging flames of the bonfire illuminated the creature's purple skin and throbbing veins. It was taller than two grown men, and its claws seemed capable of killing an ox with a single slash.
With a furious roar, the monstrosity rushed to attack. The Telestarion mutants' aggression was nothing new, in fact, you could call it their common trait. This time, however, something was wrong, as if there was something familiar in the monster's cry, something personal... Regardless of the reason for it, you had to fight for your life. Only one of you could come out of this battle alive.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38078745/78d196b96938e2971ed8f65dc20527afbfd5b7f4.jpg[/img]

Everything had happened so fast since the explosion at the "Payette" mine. First, mysterious mutations appearing more and more often, then attempts to solve the mystery of the yet unknown substance. The aged chief Atatorha (though in his own twisted way), as well as the inhabitants of Washagami - Flynn, Naismith and Sheriff Steele, all put their hand to unraveling the mystery. There was no way to let them down now. It was time to put an end to all the commotion once and for all.

[h2]Face the mighty Project Alpha and unravel its mystery![/h2]

As part of the series, we introduce you to the bosses you will encounter while exploring Washagami and the surrounding areas! Project Alpha is one of the game's key characters, and his story is the absolute core of the game's plot.

[b]Soon we will reveal the next boss you will encounter on your path.[/b]

Several hours of trudging through the forest finally brought the desired result when you broke through into a small clearing. The blinding rays of the sun hid the unusual sight stretching out before you for a moment.
[b]A huge, terrifying monster appeared before your eyes.[/b] It was almost twice the height of a grown man, but that was not its most astonishing feature. From the muscular neck grew not one, not two, but three heads! As if that were not enough, the creature had two pairs of powerful arms.
The creature gave a throaty growl and watched you closely, but did not seem particularly aggressive. Instead, you could see something akin to sadness and childlike fear in its eyes.

The search which had been going on for quite some time, began when a concerned Patrick deWitt asked for your help. He had not seen his sons for a long time, nor had he received any message from them. Amidst the dampness and chill of the underground crypt, fumes emanated that caused your eyes to pinch. The closer you got to their source, the more clouded all your senses became. A soft giggle and a rat-like sound heralded the worst. The sound of glass shattering suggested that the cause of your worries was in constant motion. [b]Passing by more light sources, you spotted a monstrous figure dressed in the robes of a servant of God.[/b] The previously unidentified stench finally took shape and manifested as the smell of alcohol consumed by this figure. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38078745/bb726b0a3558c83d56a0b24a68970947e2874076.png[/img]

With an unsteady step you began to approach a silhouette drawn in the darkness intertwined with the light of torches. You recognized in it a resemblance to Father Amareno, who, from the stories of the Washagami people, had been reported missing several years ago. A potential possession of Father Amareno's body by Satan himself was cited as the cause. However, as is often the case with urban stories, they are often not true. 

The only "Satan" for Father Amareno was his[b] unbridled love for the heart-red alcoholic beverage.[/b] Love is said to lift a person to heaven. It allows for eternal elation and resounds with the singing of birds. However, love can also be treacherous and deadly. In this case[b] its side effects will only be felt by you!
[/b]
[h2]Take up Father Amareno's challenge and plunder the legendary loot![/h2]

As part of a new series, we introduce you to the bosses you will encounter while exploring the town of Washagami! One of the first ones you may encounter early in the game is Father Amareno. Don't think that you'll be able to defeat him easily, however, as taming his lust will be a demanding task!

notes.title: Is there a larger minimap in the game?

[h1]A question asked by many...[/h1]

... will now be solved. It should be noted that it is not possible to open a larger minimap from the player level. The compass representing the minimap is available to the player from the very beginning, which is a kind of convenience.

As we have pointed out many times - [b]our game refers to the classics of the RPG genre, which of course causes that at times it is not casual enough to lead the player by the hand.[/b] Thus, having a view of the entire map is not available to the player from the very beginning.

[h2]This does not mean that there is not a larger map[/h2]

[b]However, a map of the entire Washagami exists and can be extracted while solving one of the quests in the game. [/b]However, you have to be clever and perspicacious to notice one small detail that will allow you to extract it.

From the most important information about the game:
[list]
[*] we are in ultra crunch from yesterday to the release, so [b]please be patient with communication[/b](as always we will reply to everyone, but we are fully focused on grinding and polishing the game),

notes.title: 20 hours of M.E.A.T. storyline.
notes.notes:
[b][h1]20 hours of storyline implemented![/h1][/b]
We're proud to announce that with the submission build we've met the goal set at the very beginning of our M.E.A.T. adventure - at least 20 hours of storyline.

To be more precise - [b]the gameplay has been divided into 10 hours of the main storyline and 10 hours of side quests. [/b]Thus, you will have the opportunity to spend a total of almost 24 hours in the world of Washagami!

[b][h2]But it doesn't end there![/h2][/b]
As it turned out, we got so rushed during the creation of the story content that there's a lot more [b]finished content[/b]. Because of this, we'll be adding more quests on an ongoing basis until the release, [b]which could eventually add up to 30 hours of gameplay!

Keep in mind, however, that everything depends on whether we'll have to improve some gameplay elements during M.E.A.T.'s Steam review process. Nonetheless, we are of good cheer and hope to expand the game's story content even further.

[b][h2]See you on February 14![/h2][/b]
We hope that this information will act as Cupid's arrow and on Valentine's Day we will launch M.E.A.T. together and delve into the mysterious world of Washagami! 

Finally, we encourage you to contribute to [b]our Steam forum.[/b] We're available to you every day, so if you have any questions about M.E.A.T. - go ahead - [b]create a new thread. [/b]We are always ready to give you a comprehensive answer.
